behavior.name: Capture and Calibrate Hand-Eye
behavior.author: Gabriel Novas
behavior.description:
Camera-robot (hand-eye) calibration. One calibration per camera, robot and cell (the place where that robot and that camera stand): give the cell in the parameter "cell".
1. MoveIt and RViz open. 2. Move the robot with MoveIt and press SPACE at each pose to capture a picture and the robot pose (ESC cancels). The pictures and poses of a previous capture are deleted first. 3. The board is detected in the pictures (node charuco_hand_eye). 4. The ViSP solver computes the pose of the camera.
Everything is stored in ~/calibrations/CAMERA/extrinsic_calibration/ROBOT/CELL/: - pictures/ and robot_poses/ (what was captured) - charuco_table_poses/ (the pairs used and each picture with its detection drawn) - calibration_results/camera_extrinsics.yaml (the result: robot, cell, frames, the transform and its inverse)

param.name: total_poses
param.label: Total Poses
param.hint: Number of poses to capture (minimum 5, maximum 50)

param.name: camera_type
param.label: Camera
param.hint: Camera of the calibration (a camera of charuco_calibrator/config/cameras.yaml)

param.name: robot_name
param.label: Robot Name
param.hint: Robot model: it sets the MoveIt launch, the frames and the calibration folder (charuco_calibrator/config/robots.yaml)

param.name: cell
param.label: Cell
param.hint: Cell the robot and the camera stand in (for example right, left, basic, kth_table). The calibration is stored per cell.

param.name: robot_ip
param.label: Robot IP
param.hint: Leave empty: the address of the cell is taken from the robot addresses file of the installation (UR_ONROBOT_ROBOT_ADDRESSES). Type one only to use another robot.

param.name: camera_intrinsics_file
param.label: Intrinsic Calibration
param.hint: latest (the intrinsic calibration in use, camera_intrinsics.yaml) or the name of one of the dated copies, camera_intrinsics_DATE.yaml

param.name: eye_in_hand
param.label: Eye-in-Hand
param.hint: True if the camera is on the robot, False if it is fixed

param.name: use_fake_hardware
param.label: Use Fake Hardware
param.hint: True for a simulated robot, False for the real one
